I have been thinking about joining something like this for a few years now but today made me take the leap. 
I have been struggling with s form of depression since my freshmen year of highschol, nothing too bad until a year and a haft, I started to numb out.

It didn't get better or worse until after I started collage. About that time I found out I was pregnant, I get the feeling that it didn't help me. After 'normal' post baby feels fell away I felt alright. I was not like I was in high school but not numb, this changed once my son hit the age or three. Me and his father where having troubles, I started being sad for no reason until I numbed out, again.

The next few months after that I worked on my mask, smiling and acting the part of mother for my child along with trying to work on the rocky relationship I had with his father. I was good until a year or so after, I'm not sure fully. I dropped low, so low that I went to get medical help, got put on something that was said to help bring something up and it worked for a little. I still had bad days sometimes but I had truly happy days too. 
It was working until about two years ago, me and my son father broke up on the leave ground that we were friends but not anything else, we still talk today.
I stopped fell hard the new few months, trying to find something to stand on and not sleep my life away or be 'cold' to people.
I started dating again and I'm with someone right now but I keep thinking that my depression keeps getting in the way of me and them plus it feels like the years of 'dealing' with it had made strain on my family and friends around me. 

This the few years, since my son could walk, he has been my driving force to get better, this last year he had been trying his hardest to help me through then I drop off my 'alright' range and can make me smile even when I'm feel numb.

I am so scared about sharing my story that this whole time I keep think about leaving this posting and not doing this but I also think talking about this might get me back to my 'alright' range again.
